description: Title desk physical scale specification. Comparable real-object dimensions guide scale only; the meshes are original procedural forms, not replicas of the cited brands or product shapes.
coordinate_system: Godot: X right, Y up, Z toward viewer. Layout rotations are Blender Z rotations before glTF Y-up export.

lamp.reference: Vermont Lanterns Mansfield: comparable foot diameter and total height only.

lens.reference: Eschenbach official catalogue: an 80 mm optical diameter is the selected size class; other parts retain the authored proportions.

ink.reference: Sailor 50 ml bottle: comparable 53 x 44 x 70 mm outer dimensions, not a reproduction of the product.

pen.reference: Pelikan M800 size class: selected 141 mm overall length and 13.1 mm barrel diameter; this exposed-nib prop is not a same-model or same-configuration replica.

ink.sizing_basis: Entire bottle group bounds in the unyawed bottle frame, including foot and cap. Width/depth are not the rotated world AABB.

pen.sizing_basis: Tip-to-tail projection along the authored barrel axis; barrel diameter measured perpendicular to that axis.
